```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## Global options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

# Objectives 

To assess the validity of primary and hospital care resource use and costs estimated based on OMOP-mapped CPRD data against its corresponding source data using a cohort of women with postmenopausal fragility fractures in the UK.

The cohort of interest is made of women aged >50 years with an incident fragility fracture in any site except the face, skull or digits and no history of fracture in the two years prior. The outcomes of interest are **primary** and **secondary healthcare resource utilisation** and **direct costs** associated to first incident fracture measured during the 730 days post index date or until a censoring event occurs and expressed as values per person/year. A detailed analysis plan for this study is available [here](https://github.com/LucyNjokiNjuki/OMOP-Validation-Study/raw/refs/heads/main/Analysis_plan_V.2_final.docx).

In line with the [HE Analysis Reporting Framework](https://github.com/HEOR-NDORMS/OMOP-Validation-Study/raw/refs/heads/main/HE_analysis_reporting_framework_updated.docx), both unadjusted and adjusted analyses were conducted.

This RMarkdown reports the data preparation and results for the unadjusted and adjusted analyses conducted on the **Source CPRD-HES** and **OMOP-mapped CPRD** datasets. 


# Data Preparation

The attrition table below shows the steps we followed to clean and prepare the data for the analysis.

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(here)
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(rvest)
library(DT)
library(png)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
```

## Attrition Report {.tabset}

```{r}
# Load and preprocess raw attrition report
attrition_report_raw <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_Raw.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.) | . == "NA", "", .))) %>%
  mutate(
    subjects_excluded = as.numeric(subjects_excluded),
    number_subjects = as.numeric(number_subjects),
    records_excluded = as.numeric(records_excluded)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_excluded = ifelse(!is.na(lag(number_subjects)) & lag(number_subjects) != 0,
                              round((subjects_excluded / lag(number_subjects)) * 100, 2),
                              0)
  ) %>%
  select(reason, number_records, number_subjects, subjects_excluded, percent_excluded, records_excluded)

# Load and preprocess OMOP attrition report
attrition_report_omop <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_OMOP.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(
    subjects_excluded = as.numeric(subjects_excluded),
    number_subjects = as.numeric(number_subjects),
    records_excluded = as.numeric(records_excluded)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_excluded = ifelse(!is.na(lag(number_subjects)) & lag(number_subjects) != 0,
                              round((subjects_excluded / lag(number_subjects)) * 100, 2),
                              0)
  ) %>%
  select(reason, number_records, number_subjects, subjects_excluded, percent_excluded, records_excluded)

# Extract and prepare top rows from raw
special_top_rows <- attrition_report_raw %>%
  filter(reason %in% c("Starting Population - Female individuals", "Anyone With Fracture(s)")) %>%
  select(reason, number_records, number_subjects, subjects_excluded, percent_excluded, records_excluded) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(., "_raw"), -reason)

# Merge rest of the data
merged_attrition <- full_join(
  attrition_report_raw %>% filter(!reason %in% special_top_rows$reason),
  attrition_report_omop,
  by = "reason",
  suffix = c("_raw", "_omop")
)

# Combine top rows with merged attrition table
reordered_attrition <- bind_rows(
  special_top_rows,
  merged_attrition
) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(
    reason = case_when(
      row_id <= 2 ~ reason,
      TRUE ~ paste0("  ", reason)
    )
  )

# Table 1: Starting Population
starting_population_table <- reordered_attrition %>%
  filter(str_detect(reason, "Had their.*fracture.*> ?50 years old"))

starting_population_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Starting Population**")) %>%
  tab_options(heading.align = "left", table.font.size = px(14)) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = contains("number_subjects"),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "") %>%
  cols_label(
    reason = "",
    number_subjects_raw = "Subjects (Source)",
    number_subjects_omop = "Subjects (OMOP)"
  ) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = c(contains("excluded"), contains("records"), row_id)) %>% 
  opt_stylize(style = 2)

```


```{r}
# Table 2: Exclusions (row 2 to 15)
exclusion_table <- reordered_attrition %>%
  slice(2:14)

# Get raw count from row 16
eligible_count_raw <- reordered_attrition %>%
  slice(14) %>%
  pull(number_subjects_raw)

# Get omop count from row 18
eligible_count_omop <- reordered_attrition %>%
  slice(14) %>%
  pull(number_subjects_omop)

# Create final row with eligible counts mapped to visible columns
eligible_row <- tibble(
  reason = "Number of eligible patients",
  number_subjects_raw = eligible_count_raw,
  number_subjects_omop = eligible_count_omop,
  subjects_excluded_raw = eligible_count_raw,  # map to visible column
  percent_excluded_raw = NA,
  records_excluded_raw = NA,
  subjects_excluded_omop = eligible_count_omop,  # map to visible column
  percent_excluded_omop = NA,
  records_excluded_omop = NA,
  row_id = NA
)

# Add the final row to the exclusions table
exclusion_table <- exclusion_table %>%
  bind_rows(eligible_row)


exclusion_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Attrition Table - Exclusion Criteria**")) %>%
  tab_options(heading.align = "left", table.font.size = px(14)) %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(contains("subjects_excluded"), contains("records_excluded")),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = contains("percent_excluded"),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "") %>%
  cols_label(
    reason = "Reason for exclusion",
    subjects_excluded_raw = "N Subjects Excluded",
    percent_excluded_raw = "Perc Subjects Excluded (%)",
    records_excluded_raw = "N Records Excluded",
    subjects_excluded_omop = "N Subjects Excluded",
    percent_excluded_omop = "Perc Subjects Excluded (%)",
    records_excluded_omop = "N Records Excluded"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Source Analysis",
    columns = c(subjects_excluded_raw, percent_excluded_raw, records_excluded_raw)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "OMOP Analysis",
    columns = c(subjects_excluded_omop, percent_excluded_omop, records_excluded_omop)
  ) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = c(row_id, contains("number_records"), contains("number_subjects"))) %>% 
  tab_style(
  style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
  locations = cells_body(
    rows = reason == "Number of eligible patients"
  )
)


```


# Results 

## Table 1

```{r}
# Import data
table1_data_raw <- rio::import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Table1_Raw.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .))) %>% 
  filter(Variable != "Heathcare Service Non-user Visit Status") %>% 
  filter(Variable != "Visits with Non-clinically Relevant Staff")

table1_data_omop <- rio::import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Table1_OMOP.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .))) %>% 
  filter(Variable != "Heathcare Service Non-user Visit Status") %>% 
  filter(Variable != "Visits with Non-clinically Relevant Staff")

# Define subcategories for indentation
parent_vars <- c("Fracture Site", "Censoring Event",
                 "Heathcare Service User Status") 

subcategories <- c("Hip", "Vertebra", "NHNV", 
                   "Death", "Cancer",
                   "Cancer, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture, End of Study",
                   "Paget’s disease of the bone, or other metabolic bone diseases",
                   "End of data collection period",
                   "End of data collection period, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "End of Study",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, End of Study",
                   "Non-User", "User")


# Merge datasets
merged_data <- full_join(table1_data_raw, table1_data_omop, by = "Variable", suffix = c("_raw", "_omop")) %>% 
   mutate(Variable = case_when(
    Variable %in% subcategories ~ paste0("&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;", Variable), # Indent subcategories using HTML space
    TRUE ~ Variable
  )) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .))) 

merged_data %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Patient Characteristics**")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = "Variable") %>%  # Apply markdown formatting for indentation
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>%

  # Add spanner headers for CPRD Raw and OMOP Analysis
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Source Analysis",
    columns = c("N = 23,106")
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "OMOP Analysis",
    columns = c("N = 22,900")
  ) %>%


  # Add footnotes
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Median (Q1, Q3); n (%)",
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>% 
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = md("*User defined as subjects with >=1 visit with a clinically relevant healthcare provider and Non-User as Subjects with no visits, or visits with non-clinically relevant healthcare provider, or unknown specialty*"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Variable, rows = c(21))
  )


```


## Patients Comparison between Source and OMOP

```{r}
contigency_table_for_pts_rp <- import(here("Comparison Analysis", "Results", "contigency_table_for_pts.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.) | . == "NA", "", .))) %>% 
  mutate(Total = as.numeric(Total))

contigency_table_for_pts_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Contigency Table for Patients**"),
    subtitle = md("*Comparison between OMOP and Source*")
  ) %>%
  # opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  # Add spanner headers for CPRD Raw and OMOP Analysis
  tab_spanner(
    label = "OMOP",
    columns = c("OMOP: No", "OMOP: Yes")
  ) %>%
   opt_stylize(style = 1) %>% 
  cols_label(
    `OMOP: No` = "No",
    `OMOP: Yes` = "Yes"
    ) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = contains("OMOP"),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 0
  ) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c("Total"),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 0
  ) %>% 
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "")
```

## Plots {.tabset}

### Exposure Time

Figure 1: Exposure time

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=6}
# Read images
Exposure_Time_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Exposure_Time.PNG"))
Exposure_Time_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Exposure_Time.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Exposure_Time_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Exposure_Time_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Exposure_Time_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Exposure_Time_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Exposure_Time_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Exposure_Time_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 
Exposure_Time_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Exposure_Time_OMOP_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Exposure_Time_Raw_g_with_title, Exposure_Time_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)

```

### HCRU Year 1/2 Summary Tables

```{r}
# Add a column to identify the source
unadj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_raw <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_yearly_visits_Raw-Unadjusted.xlsx"), sheet = "unadjusted_all_summary") %>%
  mutate(Source = "Source")

unadj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_omop <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Output_yearly_visits_OMOP-Unadjusted.xlsx"), sheet = "unadjusted_all_summary") %>%
  mutate(Source = "OMOP")

# Combine the data
unadj_yearly_combined_visits_rp <- bind_rows(unadj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_raw, unadj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_omop) %>% 
  select(Source, everything())

# Transpose the table
unadj_all_transposed_visits_per_year_rp <- unadj_yearly_combined_visits_rp %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(-Source, -year_after_index),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Source,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>% 
   mutate(Metric = recode(Metric,
    Source = "Data Source",
    year_after_index = "Year After Index",
    mean_visit_per_year = "Mean Visits Per Year",
    min_visit_per_year = "Minimum Visits Per Year",
    max_visit_per_year = "Maximum Visits Per Year",
    sd_visit_per_year = "SD Visits Per Year",
    median_visit_per_year = "Median Visits Per Year",
    lower_q_visits_per_year = "Lower Quartile Visits Per Year",
    upper_q_visits_per_year = "Upper Quartile Visits Per Year",
    lower = "Lower CI",
    upper = "Upper CI",
    n = "No. of Patients",
    se = "Standard Error"
  ))


# Create the gt table
unadj_all_transposed_visits_per_year_rp %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Unadjusted Analysis: All Patients - Visits Per Patient Per Year 1 & 2**"),
    subtitle = md("*Healthcare Service Users and Non-users*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    table.width = px(800),
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(contains("SOURCE"), contains("OMOP")),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 0
  )


```


```{r}
# Add a column to identify the source
adj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_raw <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_yearly_visits_Raw-Adjusted.xlsx"), sheet = "adjusted_all_summary")%>%
  mutate(Source = "Source")

adj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_omop <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Output_yearly_visits_OMOP-Adjusted.xlsx"), sheet = "adjusted_all_summary") %>%
  mutate(Source = "OMOP")

# Combine the data
adj_yearly_combined_visits_rp <- bind_rows( adj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_raw, adj_yearly_all_visits_only_rp_omop) %>% 
  select(Source, everything())

# Transpose the table
adj_all_transposed_visits_per_year_rp <- adj_yearly_combined_visits_rp %>%
```

## Costs {.tabset}

### Costs Figures - Monthly

Figure 1: Mean number of primary care consultation costs by provider specialty, users-only.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}
# Read images
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted.PNG"))
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g_with_title, Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)

```

Figure 2: Exposure-weighted mean number of primary care consultations costs by provider specialty, users-only.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}
# Read images
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted.PNG"))
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g_with_title, Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)

```

```{r}
unadj_overall_all_costs_only_rp_raw <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_costs_Raw-Unadjusted.xlsx"), sheet = "unadjusted_all_costs_summary") %>%
  mutate(Source = "Source")

unadj_overall_all_costs_only_rp_omop <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Output_costs_OMOP-Unadjusted.xlsx"), sheet = "unadjusted_all_costs_summary") %>%
  mutate(Source = "OMOP")

# Combine the data
unadj_all_combined_costs_rp <- bind_rows(unadj_overall_all_costs_only_rp_raw, unadj_overall_all_costs_only_rp_omop) %>% 
  select(Source, everything())

# Transpose the costs table
unadj_all_costs_transposed <- unadj_all_combined_costs_rp %>%
  pivot_longer(-Source, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Source, values_from = Value) %>%
  mutate(Metric = recode(Metric,
    mean_visits_cost = "Mean Visit Costs per Year",
    min_visits_cost = "Minimum Visit Costs per Year",
    max_visits_cost = "Maximum Visit Costs per Year",
    sd_visits_cost = "SD Visit Costs per Year",
    median_visits_cost = "Median Visit Costs per Year",
    q1_visits_cost = "Lower Quartile Visit Costs Per Year",
    q3_visits_cost = "Upper Quartile Visit Costs Per Year",
    lower = "Lower CI",
    upper = "Upper CI",
    n = "No. of Patients",
    se = "Standard Error"
  )) %>%
  rename(Statistic = Metric)

# Create the gt table
unadj_all_costs_transposed %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Unadjusted Analysis: All Patients - Visit Costs Per Patient Per Year**"),
    subtitle = md("*Healthcare Service Users and Non-users*")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Statistic = "Statistic",
    Source = "Source",
    OMOP = "OMOP"
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = px(800),
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c("Source", "OMOP"), 
    sep_mark = ","
  )

```
